mode.title: Mode
mode.description: futures = one row per team or player with their price and the probability it implies. markets = one row per market with the size of the field, the favourite, and how much margin the bookmaker is holding.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, wnba. A raw ESPN path such as football/nfl also works. Soccer leagues do not publish futures.

season.title: Season year
season.description: Which season's futures board to read. 0 uses the current year and falls back to the previous one if the new board is not posted yet.

marketFilter.title: Market filter (optional)
marketFilter.description: Keep only markets whose name contains one of these words, e.g. super bowl, division, mvp, champion. Empty returns every market the league lists.

entriesPerMarket.title: Entries per market
entriesPerMarket.description: How many of the shortest priced entries to return per market. An MVP market can list over a hundred players, so this is the main cost lever.

maxOdds.title: Max American odds
maxOdds.description: Drop long shots priced above this, e.g. 2000 keeps realistic contenders only. 0 = no limit.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned across all leagues and markets. Controls total cost.
